title: HemaAssist – Slick FBC Auto-Comment Web App

requirements.text: Create a single-page app UI for entering patient details (Patient Name, Patient ID) and Full Blood Count (FBC) values (Hb, RBC, WBC, Platelets, MCV, MCHC, Neutrophils, Lymphocytes, Monocytes, Eosinophils, Basophils).

quotes: I need a smart ui app which will help me with outputting FBC results. I've written the python code but I want to make the app slicker.

acceptanceCriteria: The UI contains input controls for Patient Name and Patient ID.
The UI contains input controls for each FBC field listed in the provided Python code.
The layout is responsive and usable on typical laptop screens without horizontal scrolling.

requirements.text: Implement the FBC auto-comment generation logic in the frontend to match the provided Python rules and thresholds, producing an English text report that includes patient details and the generated interpretive comments.
acceptanceCriteria: Given numeric inputs, the generated report includes a header line containing Patient Name and Patient ID in the format "PATIENT: <name>  |  ID: <id>".

Red cell comments match the Python logic: anaemia based on Hb (Low => "Anaemia present" else "No anaemia"), size based on MCV (Low => "Microcytic", High => "Macrocytic", else "Normocytic"), chroma based on MCHC (Low => "Hypochromic", High => "Hyperchromic", else "Normochromic").

White cell comments match the Python logic: WBC < 4 => "Leukopenia", WBC > 12 => "Leukocytosis", otherwise "Normal total WBC count"; differential adds Neutrophilia/Neutropenia and/or Lymphocytosis/Lymphopenia, or "Normal WBC differential" if none triggered.
Platelet comment matches the Python logic: Platelets < 150 => "Thrombocytopenia", Platelets > 450 => "Thrombocytosis", else "Normal platelet count".
All user-facing report text is in English.

requirements.text: Add robust input validation and user feedback: ensure all FBC numeric fields are required and numeric; show a clear error message when validation fails and do not generate a report.

quotes: messagebox.showerror("Input Error", "All fields must contain numeric values.")

acceptanceCriteria: If any FBC field is empty or non-numeric, the app shows an error message in English indicating that all fields must contain numeric values.
When validation fails, the previously generated report (if any) is not overwritten by a new report.
Validation behavior is consistent across all FBC numeric fields.

requirements.text: Provide a slick output panel that displays the generated report text, and include the medical disclaimer in the UI: "For laboratory assistance only. Final interpretation must be done by a qualified practitioner."

quotes: ⚠ For laboratory assistance only. Final interpretation must be done by a qualified practitioner.

acceptanceCriteria: After generating, the report is shown in a dedicated output area that supports selecting and copying text.
The disclaimer text appears on-screen and is readable without scrolling on typical laptop screens.
All user-facing disclaimer text is in English and matches the provided wording (excluding the emoji if desired).

requirements.text: Add primary user actions to improve usability: "Generate FBC Comment" button, plus convenient secondary actions such as "Clear" (reset all inputs/output) and "Copy to Clipboard" for the generated report.
acceptanceCriteria: A button labeled "Generate FBC Comment" triggers validation and report generation.
A "Clear" action resets patient fields, all numeric inputs, and the output panel.
A "Copy to Clipboard" action copies exactly the report text currently displayed, and provides an on-screen confirmation in English.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, modern visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a clinical/laboratory assistant tool, and enforce it consistently across the app.

quotes: I want to make the app slicker.

acceptanceCriteria: The UI uses a consistent visual system (typography scale, spacing, and component variants) across header, forms, buttons, and output panel.
The design avoids a default/unstyled appearance; the app looks intentionally designed and professional.
The theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary palette.

requirements.text: Generate and include required static image assets for branding (logo/app mark) and render them in the UI (served from frontend/public/assets/generated), without routing images through the backend.

quotes: HemaAssist – Full Blood Count Auto Comment

acceptanceCriteria: The generated image assets exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
A logo/app mark is visible in the UI (e.g., in the header) and looks crisp on standard and high-DPI displays.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Do not use blue & purple as the primary theme colors.
nonGoals: Do not implement or depend on the provided Python/Tkinter runtime; port the logic to this web app.
Do not add third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity (not required for this request).
Do not add external databases or third-party APIs.
Do not provide clinical decision-making beyond the specified rule-based comments; no AI/LLM interpretation.

required: Minimal hematology-themed app logo mark with a droplet + subtle blood cell motif, clean vector style, dark-on-light (hemaassist-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide header banner illustration with abstract blood cells in a soft neutral palette (no blue/purple dominance), minimal clinical aesthetic (hemaassist-banner.dim_1600x400.png)
